name: visited-tracker.setpoint-read
purpose: Read governed binding conditions, current claim invariants, queue age and fresh process-scoped storage write observations.

campaign_id.description: Campaign UUID for attention and storage observations; omission leaves those rows unavailable.

invariants: At most twenty condition rows; truncation invalidates the reading.
Missing telemetry is explicitly pending and never counted as healthy.
Fairness is an observed queue-age signal; it does not prove starvation freedom.
Claim integrity checks only currently active claims, not historical completion correctness.
Storage readings require completed samples no older than 300 seconds and directory-sync support; process epoch changes reset counters.

signals.rows: Setpoint rows: row, reading, target, in_band, unavailable, reason.

outputs.evidence: Binding-condition evidence; dormant rows are not correctness proof.
